Mirada is built to [Pauta 6.1.0](https://pauta-project.dev/6.1.0/), the adl desktop apps guidelines.
**Help › Pauta Conformance** in the app shows the same list as this page, and About names the
conformance.

## Conformance: Core

Mirada meets every MUST of this edition; 26 SHOULDs are pending.

An app conforms **Complete** when it meets every MUST and SHOULD of the edition, **Core** when
it meets every MUST, and **Partial** otherwise; a deviation, a rule that does not apply and a MAY
never count.

## Pending (26)

Rules Mirada means to meet and does not yet, each with the issue that tracks it.

| [REPO-11](https://pauta-project.dev/6.1.0/repository/#repo-11) | SHOULD | A few of the developers' helper scripts are written in Python rather than Java or shell. | [Issue #27](https://github.com/adriandeleon/Mirada/issues/27) |
